## Body

**Performance: pass-with-notes** at `b673b71012a862e1638c467bb520e816f587e4fe`. **P156-F002's failed-persistence gap is closed.**

Reviewed `011eb97..b673b71`: structured-receipt fix 42d2371e, already-reviewed main merge d8754e92, durable pre-send attempt fix b673b71.

The detector now saves an attempt before wake_pa_receipt. Error or another stretch's row means **no send**. A success consumes its persisted budget even if delivery or marking told later fails. CI executes the audit-trigger case across MAX_TELL_TRIES+2 rounds: all counter writes abort, no target gets a message; after dropping the trigger both are told. This closes the original lost-post-attempt-write loophole.

For the **current serialized watchdog producer**, every later round reloads the counter and owes stops at five, so actual send attempts are at most **five per recipient/stretch**, including errors/refusals; cancellation after reservation can consume budget without sending. The tick scheduler awaits each action (`lifecycle.rs:260-261`), with no overlap.

**Boundary qualification:** the SQL increment does not itself compare-and-cap at MAX, and the caller ignores the returned count. Arbitrary overlapping calls with stale snapshots could both reserve above the boundary; a fresh-count/SQL limit would be needed before introducing another producer or claiming a database-enforced cap. Current single-producer behavior, not such concurrency, is what the bound tests prove.

Receipt acceptance uses DeliveryOutcome, not string prefixes: Delivered/replay, Queued and Held mark told; Refused/errors remain owed. Held suppression avoids deliberately re-prompting a human. The real native-receiver refusal/recovery CI case confirms only the refused parent retries with the same ID while the PA stays told.

**Cost change:** failed sends pay one pre-send schema-checked owned attempt transaction instead of one post-failure transaction. Accepted tells now pay **attempt reservation plus told-update transactions**, in addition to existing cold-wake/queue/delivery work. Classification is constant in-process work; no new task loop, timer, poll or executable site. A persistently broken counter can still cause per-round failed admission/audit work, but no notifications.

Prior steady-state costs stand: four indexed silence SELECTs per eligible working/paned seat/round; one strict control-only capture per candidate; skip audit when control is unavailable; global stall inventory/recipient JSON, target resolution and view-query/round-latency scaling. The send cap does not eliminate capture/target-resolution work after exhaustion or bound new recipients across a changing parent/PA.

**CI:** CLEAN at this head. [CI 42395277193](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42395277193) succeeds in all four jobs; JUnit **2,143 executed cases, zero failures/errors**, five skips separately. Verified failed-attempt admission, real refusal recovery, serial bound, control-down skip, cold/lost/disabled no-launch and all six spawn guards. Latest delivers **42395280011** passes; **42395277148** was cancelled. No local tests or mutations were run.

Migration 0042/schema 42 is above main 40; 0041 remains reserved for #152. No local build, trigger, capture, model traffic or worktree edit. Full receipt/privacy/concurrency correctness remains with reviewer/security; live capture/admission/tell rates, round latency, CPU/RSS and inventory retention remain owed.
